journeys.title: Create products, suppliers and stock opening

cases.title: Opening quantity and value

cases.action: Attempt opening quantity through stock flow.
cases.expected: Non-stock products cannot acquire physical stock or inventory asset through this flow.

cases.title: Opening versus repeat
cases.action: Reload and re-submit its original accepted identity.
cases.expected: No second opening movement/journal. Missing replay identity is a contract gap, not permission to double opening.
